professionalSummary.text: Operationalized daily break-handling for Visa and Mastercard settlements at a regional acquirer, maintaining control checklist compliance with 11:00 treasury cut-off deadline.
professionalSummary.witness: Ran the daily break-handling procedure for Visa and Mastercard settlement files at a regional acquirer, working through the break queue in the reconciliation tool and ticking off the control checklist before the 11:00 treasury cut-off.

professionalSummary.text: Maintained reconciliation runbook through tool migration, adding visual aids and training two new analysts on updated procedures.
professionalSummary.witness: Rewrote the reconciliation runbook after the tool migration, adding screenshots for the new break-classification screen, and walked two newly hired analysts through it during their first fortnight.

professionalSummary.text: Documented month-end close procedures including carried-over breaks and ownership handovers with reconciliation tool ticket identifiers.
professionalSummary.witness: Wrote the month-end close notes for the reconciliation queue, listing carried-over breaks, the reason each was open and the analyst taking it over.

professionalSummary.text: Coordinated escalations with treasury and merchant services via formal escalation form, documenting responsibility boundaries with treasury manager retaining payout decisions.
professionalSummary.witness: Raised unresolved breaks above the agreed threshold to treasury and merchant services through the escalation form; the decision to hold or release a merchant payout stayed with the treasury manager.

experienceHighlights.text: Reduced break-handling time by 40% post-runbook rewrite (per team meeting slide), though baseline and period were not specified.
experienceHighlights.witness: candidate said that after the runbook rewrite breaks were 'cleared roughly 40 percent faster'; he thought the figure came from a team meeting slide but did not know the baseline or the period it covered.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Revised runbook section on break classification with screenshots and month-end close notes with reconciliation tool ticket identifiers as verification trail.
